limitations: Coverage is component-level only. A check that is valid with value 0 is not a successful obligation. Simulator alternatives are genuine local handler captures with ordinary assertions retained; each reports independent ordinary rewards beside manifest rewards. All control scenario logical reward maps matched (scalar_parity=true).
Where a destination or state is not present in the public source, no synthetic ID/state is treated as task success. Missing acknowledgement controls must remain abstentions.
